name: Video Depth Anything
paper_title: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
license: Apache-2.0 (Small checkpoint); CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Base and Large checkpoints)
license_interpretation: The licence depends on the size. The s checkpoint (Video-Depth-Anything-Small) is Apache-2.0, a permissive license that allows commercial and closed-source use if you keep the license text and notices. The b and l checkpoints (Base and Large) are CC BY-NC 4.0: attribution is required and commercial use is not allowed. The vendored code is Apache-2.0 from DepthAnything/Video-Depth-Anything at commit 4f5ae23172ba60fd7bc11ef671cca678842c7072 (Copyright ByteDance), including a motion module from AnimateDiff and attention code from Hugging Face diffusers, both Apache-2.0; the DINOv2 encoder and DPT head are shared with LibreYOLO's Depth Anything V2 family, and LibreYOLO's own adapter and streaming stitcher are MIT (libreyolo/models/video_depth_anything/NOTICE). LibreYOLO mirrors the converted checkpoints, tensors unchanged, as LibreYOLO/LibreVideoDepthAnything{s,b,l}-depth with the licence of each upstream size, not gated; metric checkpoints are not hosted.
bibtex_verified: 2026-11-15, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README at commit 4f5ae23172ba60fd7bc11ef671cca678842c7072. Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2501.12375: seven authors in the same order, identical title, primary class cs.CV; the LibreYOLO NOTICE records the paper as CVPR 2025, while the authors' entry keeps the arXiv form. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
